thread:
maria-docs: quick heads up - PR #4321 is ready for a final sweep. Needs: style/terminology pass, two link fixes, and an SDK snippet tweak before we merge today.

owen: on it. assigning myself for review but CI/docs-preview is red right now. can you paste the preview URL?

ci-bot: docs preview failed for PR #4321 - error: missing frontmatter in `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md`. full log: https://ci.internal/4321/logs

maria-docs: thanks - I'll fix the frontmatter now. also FYI the style guide prefers "end user" instead of "customer" and uses sentence-case headings. please flag any other lexicon problems.

julia: quick note on the SDK snippet in `getting-started/python.md` - currently shows a blocking sync client, we want to show the async pattern as primary. suggested replacement:```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
await client.generate("hello")
```

ben-platform: ping - platform routing changed the base path for dedicated deployments last sprint. If the migration guide references `/v1/private` can we add a note about the new `/private/v2` path and a compatibility example?

maria-docs: good catch @ben-platform, add a compatibility snippet and a small callout (why path changed + how to pin old behavior). I'll slot that into the migration doc.

owen: frontmatter fix looks fine locally. once preview is green I'll do the terminology + tone pass. can we keep the merge window to after 14:30 PST? i'm in a review block until then.

link-checker-bot: detected 2 broken links in PR #4321: `../examples/old-sdk.md` and `https://old.docs.redwood.io/faq`.

maria-docs: removed the old relative link and replaced with `/examples/python-async.md`. for the external FAQ I updated to the canonical docs redirect. pushed a tiny commit - requesting another preview build.

ci-bot: docs preview started - https://preview.internal/redwood/PR-4321

ci-bot: docs preview passed ✅ (rendering + linkcheck) - https://preview.internal/redwood/PR-4321/preview.html

owen: preview looks good. small nit: the migration example swaps header case in one snippet, can we keep original heading casing per style guide? otherwise :+1:. I'll approve after that tiny change.

julia: did a language sweep - tightened a few sentences, removed passive voice in the intro, and standardized variable names in code examples to `api_key` instead of `key`. no functional changes.

maria-docs: thanks both. I pushed the heading-case fix and the SDK snippet change to async. ready to merge after one more approval.

owen: approved. :thumbsup:

ben-platform: approved from infra side - added the compatibility note and verified path examples.

maria-docs: merging in ~5m once CI keeps green. will follow up if anything flares. thanks all for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
